ticks.note: Tick 1 enters `Outer` and `Inner`. They have no entry actions, so `step` stays 0.

Leaving runs the exit actions from the inside out (`Inner` 1, `Outer` 2), then the effect (3). Entering runs the entry actions from the outside in (`Target` 4, `First` 5). Finally `First`'s immediate transition fires in the same tick (6).
The chart rests in `Second`: nothing changes.
